title: Password reset tokens exposed in analytics events
body: Our analytics payload includes the full password reset URL and token for every reset request. This is occurring in production.

annotation.reason: Production behavior exposes security credentials and requires specialist review.

title: Update CI action to the supported major version
body: The current action version is deprecated. Builds still pass; update it before upstream support ends next quarter.

annotation.reason: This is planned dependency maintenance with no current functional impact.

title: Search returns no results for accented names
body: Searching for José returns an empty list although matching profiles exist. Searching for Jose works. This affects international users; they can search without accents as a workaround.

annotation.reason: A clear functional defect affects a user segment and has a workaround.

title: Choose whether organization names should be public
body: Some users want organization names on profiles; others say this could reveal employment information. We need a product decision before changing the page.

annotation.reason: The proposed capability has privacy implications and requires a product policy decision.
